name: YetiForce
tagline: Open source CRM with inventory, projects, finances, and HR. Polish-built.
shortDescription: A feature-rich open source CRM built in Poland. Sales, marketing, projects, inventory, finances, HR, helpdesk — everything in one self-hostable platform.
longDescription:
## What it is

YetiForce is a feature-rich open source CRM. Sales, marketing, projects, inventory, finances, HR, helpdesk, calendar, and more. Self-hostable PHP + MySQL. Translated into 30+ languages.

## Why we recommend it

If you need an all-in-one business platform (CRM + ERP + HR) and don't want multiple SaaS bills, YetiForce is the most feature-complete open source option.

## When to use it

- Mid-market companies with complex business processes
- Companies that need CRM + ERP in one
- Multi-language deployments (YetiForce is in 30+ languages)
- Replacing Salesforce/Sugar + a separate ERP
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name yetiforce -p 80:80 yetiforce/yetiforce-crm
```

**Manual:** LAMP stack + download from yetiforce.com.
pricingDetails: Open source: free. Premium support and modules from $200/month.
